title: Amsterdam 'secret space program' symposium talk on UFOs and the Kennedy assassination

tellings.quote: assumption is because of a presentation I did in Amsterdam uh around 200 I don't remember 2007 8 n something like that early 2000s um on the the secret space program was the name of this of this thing

plain: The writer Peter Levenda, billed on the show as a CIA historian, says he once gave a talk in Amsterdam, around 2007 or 2008, at a gathering about a "secret space program", a supposed hidden government effort in space, where UFOs and the Kennedy assassination came up. He tells it first-hand and says that talk is why people later assumed things about his views. He mentions the UFO writers Richard Dolan and Timothy Good in connection with it.
